records.title: 10-K
records.text: Total revenue for 2021 increased by $206.4 million to $1.9 billion as compared to 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Tractors are operated with a solo driver or, when handling more time-sensitive, higher-margin freight, a team of two drivers.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Variant continued to not only scale but outperform the legacy OTR fleet from 2019 in key metrics such as turnover, utilization, preventable accidents per million miles, and average revenue per tractor per week.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our profitability decreased largely as a result of decreased revenue miles per tractor of 7.8%, a 6.3% decrease in available tractors combined with increases in technology and personnel expenses and higher net fuel costs partially offset by an increase in our Brokerage gross margin to 12.6% compared to 8.5% in 2020 on higher Brokerage revenue.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating income for 2021 was $18.4 million compared to $43.6 million in 2020.
